Class AbstractDelegatingTileSink

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.sink.AbstractTileSink
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.sink.AbstractDelegatingTileSink
All Implemented Interfaces:
TileSink
public abstract class AbstractDelegatingTileSink extends AbstractTileSink
Shared base for TileSink decorators that wrap a delegate sink.

The C2PA (c2pa) and UltraHDR (ultrahdr) sinks both render each tile through a delegate sink and then post-process it (signing or gain-map assembly). They share the delegate plumbing: the delegate / runtime / threads options, lazy delegate resolution through Tiler.SINK_REGISTRY, delegate info.json extension merging and delegate lifecycle. That machinery lives here; subclasses only add their codec-specific work (and the WASM lane parallelism, which depends on the wasm-runtime module that core does not reference).

    • parseDelegateOptions

      protected void parseDelegateOptions(Map<String,String> options, String sinkName)
      Parses the delegate, runtime and threads options shared by every delegating sink. Call from a subclass setOptions after super.setOptions(options).
      Parameters:
      options - The raw options map (may be null).
      sinkName - Sink name used in error messages (e.g. "C2paTileSink").

    • delegate

      protected TileSink delegate()
      Returns the delegate sink, resolving it from Tiler.SINK_REGISTRY on first use (lazy so tests can inject one).

    • delegateExtension

      protected TileSink.InfoExtension delegateExtension(ImageInfo.IIIFVersion version)
      Returns the delegate sink's extension so stacked sinks (e.g. C2PA over UltraHDR) advertise both capabilities. Empty when the delegate is the plain default sink.

    • closeDelegate

      protected void closeDelegate()
      Closes the delegate if this sink created it. Injected (shared) instances are left alone.
